first_hop_predicate.reservation: Current edge fields alone are insufficient; reserve_enter sets them before EDGE_ENTER. Missing edge_exit_at cannot prove entry.
first_hop_predicate.identity: Public traversal_id is not the internal receipt traversal. No equality between them and no inverse floating subtraction is used.
first_hop_predicate.integration_required: Accepted actual NativeSession027 and fresh owner-A observe_protocol; original command query, ACK closure and complete same-time drain remain required.
first_hop_predicate.comparison_limit: Earlier root closure removes later root admissions and can change background request IDs. No unchanged-ID or tape-prefix claim transfers from the notification gate.
